---
name: Steam Frame test report
about: Results from the Frame beta (on-device or streamed)
labels: frame
---

**Mode:** on-device (SteamOS) / streamed from PC

**Self-test**
Attach `selftest-report.zip` from `./desktopvr --selftest` (on-device) or `DesktopVR.exe --selftest` (PC).

**Checklist**
- [ ] Overlay starts with SteamVR
- [ ] A screen panel shows the desktop (or says "not available on this device")
- [ ] Laser click and scroll work
- [ ] VR keyboard types into a desktop window
- [ ] Wrist shows time and batteries
- [ ] Menu opens with a double-tap on the left menu button

**Notes** (what felt off: panel distance, wrist position, keyboard size, accidental clicks)
